title: Global survey
Daily survey
question_text:
In the past 7 days:

How would you rate your pain on average?
Right now do you feel in control?

ae_describe: skin irritation under watch- mild and only when fluid is trapped between watch and skin. Participant expected this as it has also happened with her Apple watch.

Participant fell walking down hardwood stairs in her own home last week (6/14/21-6/18/21); she reports she was wearing socks and slipped and fell down half flight of stairs. She did not land on her belly/abdomen but ended up calling her OB to be cautious. OB asked her to come in for ultrasound/check-up and verified that no damage was sustained from fall. No injuries from fall.

birth_scheduled_unsure: Participant initially scheduled c-section for 8/18/21 but had c-section 2 days early as she was found to have proteinuria with urine protein of 250 mg/dl on Friday 8/13/21, and 800 mg/dl on repeat labs on Monday, 8/16/21.

scheduled?-- Elective induction at 41 weeks gestation. Per notes below, "Participant initially arrived at L&D on 9/20/2021 to be induced since she was past her due date. They used a foley balloon catheter with Pitocin. After 48 hours on Pitocin, she had still not started contractions. At that time, she was given the decision to divert to a c-section delivery. She chose to move forward with the c-section"
induction_reason: Elective induction at 41 weeks gestation. Per notes below, "Participant initially arrived at L&D on 9/20/2021 to be induced since she was past her due date. They used a foley balloon catheter with Pitocin."
birth_indication: History of preeclampsia and POTS. Elevated urine protein
birth_apgar1: unknown, unable to find in d/c paperwork
birth_describe1: He had a heart murmur at birth so they took him to the cardiologist. There is a hole at the top and bottom of his heart and one valve did not close properly. However, at a visit yesterday with her pediatrician, they could no longer hear the heart murmur. Her cardiologist follow up is next week so they are hoping everything sealed up and there are no more issues.
birth_describe2: Esophageal atresia; Baby 2 had to go in for emergency surgery to fix the connection between esophagus and stomach. Baby 1 was also born with esophageal atresia.
birth_describe: Participant had c-section 2 days before scheduled because she was found to have urine protein of 250 mg/dl on Friday 8/13/21 and follow up lab on Monday 8/16 came back at 800 mg/dl. Participant was never hypertensive and met dx criteria for preeclampsia based on proteinuria alone.
